_comment: ONE list, three readers: install.py skips these when extracting over an
existing installation, uninstall.py keeps them when removing files, and
tests/test_release_scheme.py fails if the two ever stop agreeing.
Tlamatini learned this the hard way - the updater had a preserve list and
the installer had none, so every reinstall wiped the user's settings.
Matching is on the TOP-LEVEL name inside the install directory, so an
FAIL-SAFE: if this file is missing or unparseable, both programs fall back
to their built-in copy of the same list. Keeping a user's data by mistake
is recoverable; deleting it because a JSON file did not parse is not.
